categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of hand tools, electric machinery, motors, power tools, automatic control systems, electric testing instruments, woodworking machinery, and hardware parts. Its main products include various sizes of circular saws, band saws, table saws, tile cutters, and stands, mainly categorized under electric woodworking tools. The company also engages in OEM and ODM manufacturing, including cooperation with international brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced 3D CAD design systems and coordinate measuring equipment to enhance development accuracy and shorten development time. Production involves forging, metal processing, heat treatment, surface treatment, motor manufacturing, assembly, and testing. It has ISO 9001-2015 quality certification and has obtained production certifications from major global brands. The company focuses on vertical integration to strengthen competitiveness and uses modular and common parts design to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large retail chains and distributors in the DIY electric tool market, mainly in North America, especially the United States and Canada. Key customers include major home improvement retailers such as Home Depot and Lowe’s. The products serve industries like decoration, furniture, construction, and general household repair markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main market is North America, particularly the United States and Canada, accounting for over 90% of sales. Other markets include Europe, Japan, and Australia but to a much lesser extent. The company has no manufacturing bases in China, Mexico, or the US but supports global sales through its subsidiaries and partners.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It focuses on product development, motor manufacturing, assembly, and testing, while upstream processes like forging, metal processing, and heat treatment are outsourced to specialized subcontractors within Taiwan’s mature industrial clusters. It also manages procurement and supply chain relationships with domestic and international suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include product diversification, lightweight and durable materials development, modular design, and parts commonality to reduce costs. The company invests in R&D for new product lines such as tile cutters and garden tools, and advances in brushless motor and control technologies. It emphasizes innovation to enhance product safety, environmental friendliness, and user-friendliness, aiming to increase proprietary brand market share and maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of electric tools and related components. The company operates both OEM/ODM manufacturing for international brands and sales of its own brands such as Delta, Shopmaster, and Homecraft. Additional income comes from mold services and foreign exchange gains. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include domestic manufacturers like Lishan, Dunfeng, Juting, Shengjie, and Shixing, mostly OEM/ODM players. International competitors include Black & Decker, Ryobi (TTI), Delta, Skill, Pro-Tech, Jet, Makita, Bosch, and Emerson. The company holds a significant market share in North America for 10-inch circular saws and is recognized for stable quality and strong OEM/ODM partnerships, positioning it as a leading player in the woodworking power tools segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.988 billion, a decline of 11.5% from the previous year, with net profit of NT$84 million and EPS of NT$1.06, down 27.3%. The company experienced revenue and profit declines due to inventory destocking by distributors, inflation, and reduced consumer demand. Despite challenges, it maintains stable financial health with total assets around NT$3.16 billion and equity of NT$1.99 billion, showing a solid capital structure and ongoing investment in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes innovation, efficiency, quality, and service to provide customers with competitively priced, high-quality, and convenient products. It differentiates through proprietary technology, stable product quality, and strong R&D capabilities, including patented designs and environmentally friendly materials. Its vertical integration and mature supply chain enable cost control and flexible production, while its established brand presence and OEM/ODM partnerships enhance market credibility and customer trust.
